collection: 24 frozen questions by 2 frozen seeds, all 48 runs retained
selection_time: after all 48 collection runs finish, before opening evaluation-only answers
selection_order: decisive INVALID_JUSTIFICATION of a closed literal relation with actionable_role_candidate and a live observed paragraph checkpoint
any decisive bounded relation at a live observed paragraph checkpoint
first reflection-cue event at a live observed paragraph checkpoint
ties: case_id ascending, seed ascending, step ascending, equation_index ascending; at most one event per problem ID
source_role: literal expression truth is distinct from its use in a proof; natural repair requires two independent pre-Gold full-observed-prefix reviews agreeing ASSERTED_ARITHMETIC_PROOF, otherwise no repair
source_role_review_rules: exact expression and token span must match the already observed prefix
exclude quoted false arithmetic, hypothetical/case assumptions, reductio endpoints and already repudiated arithmetic
certify only the literal expression-evaluation proof, never original-problem modelling or answer correctness
audit_cue: An explicit identical equality-audit cue is used by the three check arms. NativeContinue and UnknownIdentity receive no cue. UNKNOWN equality with NativeContinue is tested only in the no-cue UnknownIdentity arm.
proposal: first complete observed paragraph, or 192 proposal tokens, native think-close, EOS or actual context capacity; proposal guard does not cap main continuation
candidate_counterexample: only a complete JSON object with one assignment field containing exactly all target variables and bounded integer/rational values; all other outputs are UNKNOWN
verdicts: unscoped and scoped use the same checker and observed target, differing only in explicit domain predicates. No blanket acceptance of the latest reflection. Unknown adopts the already generated branch.
reject_policy: reject only a mathematically invalid counterexample to the registered target, restore the original audit checkpoint, consume post-proposal RNG, append a bounded checked reason and continue to natural EOS; never certify the old final answer
repair_eligibility: a unanimous source-role certificate, an independently replayable literal arithmetic invalidation, a READY dual-frontier plan and actual complete native token boundary
repair_evidence: all repair arms receive identical checked bad-equality evidence, all certified carry facts with provenance and the same frozen problem. Each arm may use only the already observed prefix and these facts.
repair_decisions: cut selection and carry precede all arm outputs and all evaluation-only answer reads. No learned controller or selective rerunning by correctness.
cost_matching: report actual full prefix/decode/branch/replay work. Resampling is independent native generation with the same checked evidence. Only compare a budget-matched bracket after all paid work is counted, never claim equal cost from equal max tokens.
main_generation: natural EOS or loaded model actual context limit, no scientific new-token or wall-time cap
scoring: evaluation-only answers opened only after selection, role review, protocol and all paired generation are frozen. Same final-response LastBox and math scorer for every arm.
claims: CPU tests, replay identity, natural checker coverage, conditional intervention quality and full-bank answer accuracy are reported separately
